# Exec instructions

The `.exec` stack is the program still to run: the interpreter pops its top item each step and executes it. These instructions loop, branch and rearrange what is pending. Their bodies come from `.code`.

## The stack's own instructions

Every stack has the same family for copying, deleting, reordering and measuring its items; see <doc:StackInstructions>. On `.exec` they are `execDeepDup`, `execDeleteAtDepth`, `execDup`, `execDupItems`, `execDupTimes`, `execFlush`, `execPop`, `execPopItems`, `execRot`, `execShove`, `execStackDepth`, `execStackIsEmpty`, `execSwap`, `execYank`, `execYankDup`.
